attempts.summary: Established a site-to-site IPsec (IKEv2, AES256/SHA256) tunnel between node1 (VyOS, transit 10.10.3.1) and node2 (OPNsense, transit 10.10.3.2), carrying lan-a (10.10.1.0/24, node3 behind node1) and lan-b (10.10.2.0/24, node4 behind node2) across it. node3 and node4 reach each other by their private addresses (10.10.1.10 <-> 10.10.2.10) with traffic encrypted in transit (verified only ESP frames cross the transit wire). All configuration is persisted (VyOS config saved to config.boot; OPNsense config.xml with Swanctl connection/PSK/firewall rules; NetworkManager static routes on node3/node4; an rc.syshook boot script on node2 for its static route to lan-a). All four nodes were restarted one at a time with confirmed changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery of the tunnel, routes, and end-to-end connectivity.
